summary: Iteration 12 — full-stack testing of RAW AI Learning module + new /styles page + Dashboard progress card + regression on existing endpoints. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass on the public preview URL. Frontend: session cookie injected in Playwright, dashboard project card renders status pill + progress bar + 'X fotografías · estado', nav buttons (Proyectos/Estilos/Aprendizaje/Perfiles) navigate correctly with active emerald highlight, /styles renders PhotographerStyles component, /learning uploads XMP files → shows 'Tu firma de revelado' summary + basic (8) + creative (3) tendency grids, save+activate+delete personal profile flow works.

issues: Status text is rendered as the raw English status key ('created'/'processing'/'completed') in 'X fotografías · estado' — the pill above already shows the localized Spanish label ('Nuevo'/'En proceso'/'Completado'); the inline text should use the localized STATUS[p.status].label instead of p.status for consistency in the Spanish UI.

action_items: Minor UI polish: in /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx line ~83, replace `{p.status}` with `{st.label}` inside the 'X fotografías · estado' subtitle so the status text is displayed in Spanish and matches the pill.
Non-blocking: server.py is now 1242 lines — consider splitting learning + extractor + xmp helpers into modules (already flagged in iteration_11).
critical_code_review_comments: learning_analyze correctly returns 400 on empty samples, aggregates per key with mean/min/max/count, buckets into basic vs creative, and rounds exposure to 2 decimals and others to int — matches spec.
create_personal_profile: 'first profile becomes active=true' logic uses count_documents on user's profiles — correct and race-safe enough for a single-user usage pattern.
activate_personal_profile deactivates all others then activates target atomically enough (two sequential updates) — acceptable; would be safer in a transaction but not critical.
Per-user scoping verified: user B cannot see user A's profiles (listing filtered by user_id).
Delete returns 404 for unknown ids — correct.
Dashboard.jsx renders status via localized STATUS map for the pill but leaks the raw English key in the subtitle — cosmetic bug (see design_issues).
test_credentials: Seeded two ephemeral users + sessions in test_database (TOKEN_A/TOKEN_B). Cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 2 users + 2 sessions; created 1 project (TEST_UI_iter12) and 1 personal profile (TEST_UI_profile) via UI, then deleted via UI/DB cleanup. Backend tests also created + deleted TEST_-prefixed personal profiles and a TEST_iter12_proj project.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration12_learning.py expects TOKEN_A/TOKEN_B env vars (seed via /app/memory/test_credentials.md snippet). It uses class-based scheduling with pytest-xdist loadscope so all tests in TestPersonalProfiles run on the same worker (needed because they share a module-level _created_ids list). If refactoring, keep them in the same class or pass -n 0. Playwright must add session_token cookie for domain ai-xmp-gen.preview.emergentagent.com BEFORE navigating to any /dashboard route.

verified_behavior.learning_analyze: 200 with samples count, basic{}, creative{}, per-key stats{mean,min,max,count}, Spanish summary. 400 on empty samples. 401 unauth.
verified_behavior.personal_profiles_crud: First profile for user auto-activates. Second stays inactive. PATCH /activate flips exclusive-active. Listing scoped per user (user B does not see user A profiles). DELETE 404 on unknown id.
verified_behavior.regression: GET /projects, POST /projects + GET/DELETE persistence, GET /photographer-styles, POST /selection/analyze (with & without files) all still working.
verified_behavior.frontend_nav: AppShell renders 4 nav buttons (nav-dashboard-btn, nav-styles-btn, nav-learning-btn, nav-profiles-btn); active button gets emerald-400/40 border+bg+text classes.
verified_behavior.frontend_learning: XMP upload → parseXmp extracts crs:Exposure2012/Contrast2012/... → POST /learning/analyze → summary + 8 basic + 3 creative tendency cells rendered; save-btn creates profile card with activate/delete controls.
verified_behavior.frontend_styles: /styles renders style-library container hosting PhotographerStyles component.
verified_behavior.frontend_dashboard_card: project-card-{id} shows Spanish status pill ('Nuevo'), subtitle 'X fotografías · created' (raw key — minor bug), and progress bar div with computed width.
